defmodule Mix.Tasks.Todo.Add do
  use Mix.Task

  @shortdoc "Add a task"

  @impl Mix.Task
  def run([title | _rest]) do
    Mix.Task.run("app.start")
    task = TinyTasks.add(title)
    Mix.shell().info("Added task #{task.id}: #{task.title}")
  end

  def run([]), do: Mix.raise("Missing task title. Usage: mix todo.add TITLE")
end

defmodule Mix.Tasks.Todo.Complete do
  use Mix.Task

  @shortdoc "Complete a task"

  @impl Mix.Task
  def run([id]) do
    number =
      case Integer.parse(id) do
        {number, ""} -> number
        _ -> Mix.raise("Invalid task ID #{id}")
      end

    Mix.Task.run("app.start")

    case TinyTasks.complete(number) do
      :ok -> :ok
      {:error, :not_found} -> Mix.raise("Task #{id} not found")
    end
  end

  def run([]), do: Mix.raise("Missing task ID. Usage: mix todo.complete ID")
end
